description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Edge], [ATK and MAG +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Water/Fire/Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 or 66.00 each) capped at 199,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Water, Fire, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Water, Fire, Lightning Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Tactical Chase Mode: Edge] to user if Level 2+ EnWater or EnFire or EnLightning, grants [Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Water, Fire, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Water, Fire, or Lightning attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Tactical Chase Mode: Edge
description.text: Triggers [Battle Strike: Edge] when using Water/Fire/Lightning abilities (max 5)

description.name: Battle Strike: Edge
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.90 or 457.50 each) based on ATK, and MAG.

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
